report.incidentSummary: Starting around 10:10 IST (04:40 UTC) on 2026-10-15, UPI autopay mandate setup success rate for SIPs dropped from ~96.2% to ~93.4%. Investigation revealed that the issue was isolated to partner bank Sahyadri Bank, whose POST /mandates API on bank-apis began timing out after 8000ms, causing Sahyadri mandate success rate to fall from ~96.5% to ~68%. The recent mandate-service deployment at 09:52 IST (04:22 UTC) was ruled out because success rates remained normal for 18 minutes post-deploy and all other banks remained unaffected.
report.rootCauseStatement: External partner bank Sahyadri Bank's mandate API (bank-apis POST /mandates) degraded starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00Z (10:10 IST), resulting in response times exceeding bank-connector's configured 8000ms timeout for ~31-34% of requests. bank-connector returned BANK_TIMEOUT to mandate-service, causing Sahyadri Bank mandate registration success to fall from ~96.5% to ~68% and overall platform mandate success to decline to ~93.4%. The mandate-service deployment at 09:52 IST was coincidental and was not the cause.

hypotheses.cause: Sahyadri Bank's partner API (bank-apis) experienced elevated latency on POST /mandates exceeding the 8000ms timeout configured on bank-connector, causing ~30-34% of Sahyadri mandate setups to fail with BANK_TIMEOUT.
hypotheses.rationale: Directly supported by 504 Gateway Timeout errors after 8000ms logged by bank-connector when calling bank-apis for Sahyadri Bank starting at 04:40:00Z (10:10 IST), with bank_latency_p95_ms hitting the 8000ms ceiling, timeout_count rising to ~13-18/min, and 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors recorded by mandate-service exclusively for Sahyadri Bank.

hypotheses.cause: mandate-service release 2.4.0 (CHG-48217) deployed at 04:22:00Z (09:52 IST) introduced a software regression or polling bug causing mandate setup failures.
hypotheses.rationale: Ruled out by timing and scope: mandate-service 2.4.0 ran for 18 minutes post-deploy with normal success rates (~96.2% overall, ~96.5% for Sahyadri), successfully approved Sahyadri mandates in 2265ms, and the degradation starting at 04:40Z was isolated entirely to Sahyadri Bank's external API timing out in bank-connector after 8000ms, while all other banks operated normally.

hypotheses.cause: NPCI e-mandate / UPI autopay central switch degradation.
hypotheses.rationale: Ruled out because only Sahyadri Bank was affected while four other partner banks were healthy, and mandate-service logged zero NPCI-related errors.

facts.statement: mandate-service was deployed with version 2.4.0 (CHG-48217) at 2026-10-15T04:22:00.000Z (09:52 IST).
mandate-service v2.4.0 successfully approved mandate MD-8071210 for bank sahyadri in 2265ms at 2026-10-15T04:28:56.440Z (09:58:56 IST).
Between 04:22:00Z and 04:35:00Z, overall mandate success rate remained normal at ~96.2%, and Sahyadri Bank mandate success rate remained normal at ~96.5%.
Starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z (10:10:00 IST), bank-connector logged 504 Gateway Timeout errors after 8000ms on POST /mandates specifically for bank sahyadri.
Between 04:40:00Z and 07:00:00Z, mandate-service logged 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors, all 402 of which occurred for bank sahyadri.
In bank-connector, Sahyadri Bank's p95 latency jumped from ~1600ms to ~8000ms, error rate increased from ~0.8% to ~31-34%, and timeout_count rose from 0 to ~11-18 timeouts/min starting at 04:40:00Z.

Other partner banks (gomti, indus_valley, kaveri, northstar) maintained normal mandate success rates (~95.8-96.8%), normal bank latencies (~1700-2400ms), and normal error rates (<1.0%) throughout the window.
Other bank-connector operations for Sahyadri Bank such as POST /debits continued to succeed normally with response times between 1091ms and 1506ms.
There were no NPCI-related warnings or errors logged by mandate-service during the incident window.
Sahyadri Bank mandate requests accounted for ~13-18 requests/min out of ~140 requests/min total mandate traffic (~10-11% of total).

inferences.statement: Overall mandate success rate dropped by only ~2.8 percentage points (from ~96.2% to ~93.4%) because Sahyadri Bank represents only ~10-11% of total mandate setup requests and ~68% of Sahyadri requests still succeeded.
The mandate-service deployment at 04:22:00Z was merely coincidental and was not the cause of the degradation starting at 04:40:00Z.

The degradation at Sahyadri Bank was specific to their mandate registration API endpoint (/mandates) rather than general bank-wide network connectivity, as debits continued to respond normally in ~1.1-1.5s.

assumptions.statement: Sahyadri Bank's internal mandate API processing subsystem experienced backend delays or queuing leading to request latencies exceeding the 8000ms gateway timeout.

timeline.event: mandate-service version 2.4.0 deployed (CHG-48217).
mandate-service v2.4.0 successfully approves mandate MD-8071210 for Sahyadri Bank in 2265ms.
bank-connector records the first 504 Gateway Timeout after 8000ms calling bank-apis POST /mandates for bank sahyadri.
mandate-service logs the first mandate failure due to bank-connector BANK_TIMEOUT for bank sahyadri.
In bank-connector, Sahyadri Bank p95 latency reaches 4778ms and bank error rate reaches 15.21%. Sahyadri mandate success rate drops to 82.26%.
Sahyadri Bank p95 latency reaches the 8000ms timeout threshold (7902ms), bank error rate stabilizes at ~31-34%, and Sahyadri mandate success rate drops to ~66.23%.
Overall platform mandate success rate stabilizes at ~93.4%, as observed on payments dashboard.

confidence.rationale: The timing, error logs, and metric breakdowns decisively isolate the failure to external API timeouts on Sahyadri Bank's /mandates endpoint. The mandate-service deployment occurred 18 minutes prior and processed Sahyadri mandates successfully without issues, ruling out deployment regression. All other partner banks and other Sahyadri endpoints (e.g. debits) remained unaffected.

gaps.description: bank-apis is an external partner system, so internal telemetry, logs, and root cause details within Sahyadri Bank's infrastructure are unavailable.
gaps.impact: We cannot determine the specific internal defect or capacity constraint within Sahyadri Bank's servers that caused their mandate API latency to spike.

gaps.description: Tool call ev_36 for bank-connector error logs across 04:00-07:00 was partially returned by the log store.
gaps.impact: Minimal; complete log queries for the onset window (ev_7, ev_14, ev_15) and complete metrics (ev_9, ev_10, ev_11) provide full visibility into the error patterns.

recommendedActions.action: Escalate the issue to Sahyadri Bank's API technical operations team, reporting elevated latency and 8000ms gateway timeouts on their POST /mandates endpoint starting at 10:10 IST on 2026-10-15.
recommendedActions.rationale: The root cause resides in Sahyadri Bank's mandate API infrastructure, which requires remediation by the partner bank.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor bank-connector timeout_count and bank_latency_p95_ms for bank sahyadri until latency drops below 2500ms and timeouts return to 0.

recommendedActions.action: Display an in-app notice or advisory for users attempting to set up SIP autopay using Sahyadri Bank accounts, suggesting retrying later or selecting an alternate bank account.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents user frustration and failed SIP registrations while Sahyadri Bank resolves their upstream mandate API performance issues.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify in-app client telemetry shows users receiving the advisory on mandate setup flows when Sahyadri Bank is selected.

recommendedActions.action: Configure granular, bank-specific alerting on bank-connector timeout_count and mandate-service mandate_success_rate per bank.
recommendedActions.rationale: Overall dashboard metrics diluted the single-bank impact, leading team members to suspect an internal deployment rather than quickly identifying the partner bank degradation.
recommendedActions.verification: Trigger a test alert rule on synthetic bank latency/timeout anomalies and ensure notifications specify the degraded bank name.

recommendedActions.action: Evaluate circuit-breaking and fallback queueing in mandate-service and bank-connector for partner bank mandate registration timeouts.
recommendedActions.rationale: Fast-failing or queueing mandate registration requests during partner bank degradation avoids holding worker connections for the full 8000ms timeout window.
recommendedActions.verification: Run chaos test simulating 8000ms bank latency and verify circuit breaker opens and provides graceful degradation within configured error thresholds.

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
Starting around 10:10 IST (04:40 UTC) on 2026-10-15, UPI autopay mandate setup success rate for SIPs dropped from ~96.2% to ~93.4%. The mandate-service deployment at 09:52 IST was coincidental and was not the cause.

   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_11, ev_14, ev_15, ev_34, ev_35] · Contradicting: none
   - Directly supported by 504 Gateway Timeout errors after 8000ms logged by bank-connector when calling bank-apis for Sahyadri Bank starting at 04:40:00Z (10:10 IST), with bank_latency_p95_ms hitting the 8000ms ceiling, timeout_count rising to ~13-18/min, and 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors recorded by mandate-service exclusively for Sahyadri Bank.
2. **mandate-service release 2.4.0 (CHG-48217) deployed at 04:22:00Z (09:52 IST) introduced a software regression or polling bug causing mandate setup failures.** — `mandate-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.02, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_2] · Contradicting: [ev_3, ev_4, ev_7, ev_9, ev_16]
   - Ruled out by timing and scope: mandate-service 2.4.0 ran for 18 minutes post-deploy with normal success rates (~96.2% overall, ~96.5% for Sahyadri), successfully approved Sahyadri mandates in 2265ms, and the degradation starting at 04:40Z was isolated entirely to Sahyadri Bank's external API timing out in bank-connector after 8000ms, while all other banks operated normally.
3. **NPCI e-mandate / UPI autopay central switch degradation.** — `npci`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.01, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_3, ev_15, ev_33]
   - Ruled out because only Sahyadri Bank was affected while four other partner banks were healthy, and mandate-service logged zero NPCI-related errors.

## Facts
- mandate-service was deployed with version 2.4.0 (CHG-48217) at 2026-10-15T04:22:00.000Z (09:52 IST). [ev_2]
- mandate-service v2.4.0 successfully approved mandate MD-8071210 for bank sahyadri in 2265ms at 2026-10-15T04:28:56.440Z (09:58:56 IST). [ev_16]
- Between 04:22:00Z and 04:35:00Z, overall mandate success rate remained normal at ~96.2%, and Sahyadri Bank mandate success rate remained normal at ~96.5%. [ev_3, ev_4]
- Starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z (10:10:00 IST), bank-connector logged 504 Gateway Timeout errors after 8000ms on POST /mandates specifically for bank sahyadri. [ev_7]
- Between 04:40:00Z and 07:00:00Z, mandate-service logged 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors, all 402 of which occurred for bank sahyadri. [ev_8, ev_34, ev_35]
- In bank-connector, Sahyadri Bank's p95 latency jumped from ~1600ms to ~8000ms, error rate increased from ~0.8% to ~31-34%, and timeout_count rose from 0 to ~11-18 timeouts/min starting at 04:40:00Z. [ev_9, ev_10, ev_11]
- Other partner banks (gomti, indus_valley, kaveri, northstar) maintained normal mandate success rates (~95.8-96.8%), normal bank latencies (~1700-2400ms), and normal error rates (<1.0%) throughout the window. [ev_3, ev_9, ev_10]
- Other bank-connector operations for Sahyadri Bank such as POST /debits continued to succeed normally with response times between 1091ms and 1506ms. [ev_32]
- There were no NPCI-related warnings or errors logged by mandate-service during the incident window. [ev_33]
- Sahyadri Bank mandate requests accounted for ~13-18 requests/min out of ~140 requests/min total mandate traffic (~10-11% of total). [ev_17]

## Inferences
- Overall mandate success rate dropped by only ~2.8 percentage points (from ~96.2% to ~93.4%) because Sahyadri Bank represents only ~10-11% of total mandate setup requests and ~68% of Sahyadri requests still succeeded. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_17]
- The mandate-service deployment at 04:22:00Z was merely coincidental and was not the cause of the degradation starting at 04:40:00Z. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_16]
- The degradation at Sahyadri Bank was specific to their mandate registration API endpoint (/mandates) rather than general bank-wide network connectivity, as debits continued to respond normally in ~1.1-1.5s. [ev_7, ev_9, ev_32]

## Assumptions
- Sahyadri Bank's internal mandate API processing subsystem experienced backend delays or queuing leading to request latencies exceeding the 8000ms gateway timeout.

## Timeline
